title: Qualify immutable electrochemical publisher using only the original RS174 archive
commitMessage: test: qualify immutable electrochemical publisher on original candidate bytes

contribution.summary: Qualify the shared immutable publisher against the exact original RS174 electrochemical Standard archive in a disposable feed, without rebuilding or publishing to NUGET_LOCAL.
contribution.value: Prove seven bounded publication controls with the original archive, complete ZIP inventory and pinned DLL; preserve both exact dependencies, old Standard bytes and acquired source/binary evidence. Establish the next local-delivery trust gate for the AURA unit-profile request.
debtChanges: RS174 succeeded at attempt 001 after three pre-attempt refusals; firstPassSucceeded is false. Its twelve binary checks and three loaded DLL hashes remain acquired evidence.
The original Standard 20260.20261110.1001 archive is the only admitted input. Missing or changed bytes refuse; no rebuilding, repacking or same-version substitution is permitted.
Disposable DWF preparation may read only the pinned archive under the exact approved operator checkout. It never executes there, searches sibling repositories or writes to the operator archive.
Reuse Dw.Tools.NuGet [20260.20261026.1010]. No shared-feed publication, old package overwrite, source or binary campaign replay, public release, license choice or AURA completion is claimed.
M1 and M3 remain done; all 541 native nodes and backlog 0.1.122 are retained. No completion achievement is declared for this bounded delivery qualification.
contribution.nextAction: After durable success, publish the identical original archive without overwrite to NUGET_LOCAL under the existing owner authorization, then independently verify the physically published archives and loaded DLLs in a separate gate.
